summary: Ground explicitly written revision labels as atomic cited values and keep them scoped to exact workflow identities and source findings.
decision_refs: The active goal requires continued RFI, Submittal and Email accuracy and adaptability
The product retains internal revision context but must not infer revision authority
An offline reproduction proved that an alphabetic revision from another RFI was accepted because existing value guards did not cover it
approval_evidence: The persistent objective authorizes deterministic answer-accuracy improvements across RFI, Submittal and Email content.
known_limitations: Only explicitly written Revision or Rev forms with bounded label shapes are interpreted.
Evidence metadata alone, unlabelled codes, arbitrary prose and revision-date wording do not support a revision-label claim.
The guard does not determine chronology, applicability, contractual authority, precedence or whether every relevant file was parsed.
